content.body:
With the imminent threat of Germany invading Britain and the demand on SMG's being incredibly high, the Sten Gun was born as a cheap and effective alternative. It was in service from 1941 to the 1960's, and was apart of almost every major conflict throughout that time period.
This limited smg is available for free players as an introductory weapon. By upgrading to a starter or premium account you will receive access to more weapons and vehicles the game has to offer.
content.brief: WEAPON: Sten Mk. II AMMO: 9x19mm Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 round MUZZLE VELOCITY: 365 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 500+/- rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: No.36 Mills Bomb HE Grenades (1) Combat Knife
